newsitem.title: NORWAY: Statoil plans Heidrun North development.
newsitem.headline: Statoil plans Heidrun North development.

text.p: Den norske stats oljeselskap AS (Statoil) said on Thursday the Heidrun North discovery in the Haltenbanken area off mid-Norway is to be developed via subsea wells tied back to the Heidrun platform.
Production from the satellite discovery, which lies 10 km northeast of the main field, could begin as early as summer 1999, Statoil's Status Weekly newsletter said.
A plan for development and operation is due to be submitted this year. Statoil said daily production was put at between 20,000 and 40,000 barrels per day.
"The extent of recoverable reserves has not yet been fully clarified, and an appraisal well could be drilled this year or next to get a better estimate," the newsletter said.
